dct_title_s: Europe NUTS 1 Demographics : ESRI Data & Maps 2007
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Europe NUTS 1 Demographics represents areas of aggregated socioeconomic and demographic information at the NUTS 1 level for Europe. NUTS 1 units have a population between three million and seven million people. NUTS (Nomenclature des Unit?s Territoriales Statistiques) refers to the Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics. For more information: http://europa.eu.int/comm/eurostat/ramon/nuts/introduction_regions_en.html.
Purpose: Europe NUTS 1 Demographics provides NUTS 1 level demographic information for Europe.
Supplemental information: Largest scale when displaying the data: 1:200,000.
